ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels dominate approximately 90% of the fluke surface area, with high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels comprising localized clusters representing <10% of total surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black base (low-intensity). High-contrast white/cream rosettes and circular clusters concentrated heavily on the distal tips. Scattered circular and linear white pixel clusters distributed across the central and medial regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 45-50 degrees relative to the medial horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 10-30 pixels; extreme jaggedness at the distal tips due to bio-protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge from the notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a slight convexity towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed white circular clusters at both fluke tips; individual circular ring-like scars visible on the left lobe at central coordinates; scattered smaller white spots across the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical high-contrast white linear mark on the left inner lobe; several faint diagonal and horizontal linear pixel disruptions on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization causing major structural irregularities at the distal-most tips of both lobes; visible white rake-like scratches on the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced biofouling (parasitic clusters) creating a lumpy, non-geometric silhouette at the extreme edges of the lobes.
